title: fix(stripe-atlas): guard stripe-atlas page in self-hosted mode
body:
As @~kekekuli pointed out rightfully [here](https://linear.app/supabase/review/featstripe-atlas-wire-up-redemption-flow-ab3446c53e5d#comment-61e59655), the stripe atlas pages can be visited in self-hosted mode, but they don't make any sense there.

Since the flow is initiated on the stripe atlas dashboard, let's just show 404s in self-hosted.

<!-- This is an auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->
## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **Bug Fixes**
  * The Stripe Atlas application now opens only on the supported hosted platform. Attempts to visit it elsewhere lead to a not-found page. Application data is fetched only when the platform context is active and the required access token is configured, keeping the application experience consistent with the environments where it is supported.
<!-- end of auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->
